questions.question: Which of the following is the correct English pronunciation for the number '1'?
'The English pronunciation for the letter 'A' is 'ay'' is a True statement.
Which of the following is the correct English pronunciation for the number '5'?
'The English pronunciation for the letter 'B' is 'bee'' is a True statement.
Which of the following is the correct English pronunciation for the number '10'?
'The English pronunciation for the letter 'C' is 'see'' is a True statement.
Which of the following is the correct English pronunciation for the number '20'?
'The English pronunciation for the letter 'D' is 'dee'' is a True statement.
